name: tracker
description: The life cycle of audit findings in GitHub issues: open the missing issues from scanner runs or any findings file (deduplicated by a key written into each issue), sync them with later scans (close what was resolved, reopen what came back), triage open issues against the current code with a skeptic counter-check, and fix them in batches — one branch, one worktree and one draft pull request per batch.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the plugin: en (English), fr (Français), es (Español), de (Deutsch).

fixer_scope.title: Fixer
fixer_scope.description: Who fixes the issues of a batch or a lot: issue (one fixer agent per issue), batch (one agent per batch), session (no agent: the session fixes them itself — fewer tokens, the code read stays in the session). The project's batch.fixer wins.

batch_worktree.title: Batch worktree
batch_worktree.description: true: each batch or lot gets its own worktree, your checkout does not move. false: the fix/ branch is created in your checkout (tracked files clean), no worktree and no setup; the checkout goes back after the pull request. The project's batch.worktree wins.

triager_model.title: Model — triager
triager_model.description: Model of the triager agents: inherit (the session's model), haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Default: sonnet.

triager_effort.title: Effort — triager
triager_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the triager agents: inherit (the session's effort), low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: medium.

skeptic_model.description: Model of the skeptic agents: inherit (the session's model), haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Default: inherit.

skeptic_effort.title: Effort — skeptic
skeptic_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the skeptic agents: inherit (the session's effort), low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: inherit.
